name: Occultus
source:
Occultus is an adult visual novel about vampires, cults and the debauched lifestyles of the wealthy elite of a small town called Moroburg.

You will play as a young man who, after meeting his estranged Aunt when looking for work, discovers the weird and wonderful dark underbelly of his home town.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/BC_games]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《Occultus》是一部成人视觉小说，讲述吸血鬼、邪教与小镇莫罗堡富裕精英阶层的腐化生活。

你将扮演一名年轻人。他为寻找工作与疏远的姨妈相遇后，发现故乡阴暗面古怪而奇妙的内幕。

[据[url=https://www.patreon.com/BC_games]Patreon[/url]编辑]
